title: 第13章 再续仙道潜力 求推荐求月票第14章 不是面子 求推荐求月票
content_zh:
复盘中，一个念头在楚无忌心中涌现，炼丹必须可量化、工程化、标准化。
楚无忌已经吃过亏：所谓“闻到微苦刺鼻便降三分火力”，听着像诀窍，落到炉前却全凭人心与感觉。
今日觉得“微苦”，明日或许就是“焦苦”；今日降“三分”恰好，换了炉膛湿一点、火灵砂杂一点，那“三分”便成了笑话。更何况各人感官灵敏不同、神识强弱不同，同一句话落到不同人手里，炼出的东西便天然参差。
炼丹像极了凡俗的炼药与前世化工：灵材、火候、时辰、炉体状态是输入；炉内药气翻涌、传热对流、神识控制、药性相互牵制是过程；成丹率、药力强弱、杂质多少、这些是输出。
既然输入有可操作之处，输出又能验证比较，那便不该全靠个人经验与感觉。运气好时，炼丹学徒都能说自己懂火候；运气坏时，正式炼丹师谁也说不清错在何处。
他很清楚，自己不是什么天纵奇才，更没资格靠个人经验吃饭。
靠个人经验、感觉的人，一炉大成功便自以为通了丹道，一炉炼废了便把锅甩给天意；而他要的是，找出可复现的工艺窗口，把炼丹技艺从凭感觉一点点逼到有据可查，错了能追，改了能验，下一炉还能照着做出来。
于是第三炉，他不再急着求成，而是把所有步骤都拆开分析。
药材先烘干，去潮；再研磨，控制粗细；再筛分，使粒径尽可能一致。
取用药材时，他使用神识从小颗粒慢慢增加，宁可慢些，也不许药材分量误差乱飘。他知道低阶聚灵散炼制时看似粗陋，实则最怕差不多，差一分，最后便差一炉。
丹炉先点检，上次炼丹后，炉膛是否清洗、火焰阵法是否稳定、降温升温控制是否流畅都看一遍，尽量把每次炼丹的起点拉到同一条线上。
控火更不凭经验去猜什么“三分”。
他在玉简上逐炉画出升温、保温与降温三段的时间刻度，把升温速率与稳温平台都确定，哪一段爬升，哪一段稳住，哪一段再转入降温，都按自己记下的节点，一息一息掐得分毫不差。
再拿这些曲线与这一炉成丹的结果逐一对照，最终归纳出一条最推荐的时间温度曲线。
当炉盖再启，热浪扑面，却不呛人。
那股药气冲出来时清而不浊，既不刺鼻，也不带焦酸，只在鼻端轻轻一掠，法力都隐隐有所触动。
那一炉出散时，香气清正，带着一丝干净的凉意；药粉细如尘霜，落入玉盘时松而不散，不见结块，也不见灰点。
楚无忌盯着那层薄薄药粉看了片刻，眸光微微一亮，可操作的输入被精确量化后，再在控制阶段不发生过错，那么可预期的输出，品质良好的聚气散也就出炉了。
炼丹并非只能靠炼丹师的感觉，只是从来没有炼丹师愿意把它写得这么明白。
聚气散这等炼气期弟子常服的低阶药散，勉强算是练气级灵药，本就不必凝粉成丹，散装亦可。

宗门里年年开炉，炼制次数多得数不清，样本量一旦堆起来，便足以从中推得有统计意义的最佳配比与火候区间。只是此等最优，终究是对大多数炉次而言的稳妥之选，落到某一炉、某一炼丹师、某一回丹炉炉膛湿润或药材年份稍浅一点的细微差别上，仍难做到分毫不差的完全预测。
至于筑基乃至结丹修士服用的高阶丹药，则另是一番光景。
高阶丹药往往需要千年灵药与天材地宝。其物稀而贵，动辄一株难求，哪怕想做对照试验，也经不起这般消耗。样本一少，试验规模便被生生卡住，许多变量只能靠推演与小心试探，难以像低阶丹药那般反复迭代、层层逼近，从而获得最佳炼制方案。
因此这种工程化方案大概只能适用练气，乃至一部分成本不甚昂贵的筑基期丹药，不过即便这样，想来其能提升的炼丹成功率也不输一些筑基级炼丹秘法了。
不过目前毕竟只在练气级的聚气散上实验过，要真正称之为筑基级炼丹秘法，还是得成功应用在筑基修士服用的筑基期丹药上，届时纵有人存心挑刺，也只能哑口无言，再无推诿之处。
恰好楚无忌如今不过炼气八层，离筑基尚有一段时日可供打磨。他打算成为练气级炼丹师后，便先挑一味最简单、用料最省的筑基丹药试手，以此为基，一炉一炉慢慢推衍，把工程化方案应用到筑基期丹药上，使之成为名副其实的筑基级炼丹秘法。
......
时光荏苒，转眼四年。
也许是得益于穿越带来的相较于同阶修士强大三四分的神识，在炼丹术上，楚无忌终于有了一点点进展。
借着这份神识强度，他把控火、分药、凝丹的细节一寸寸磨到可复现的程度，又在聚气散工程化基础上，接连吃透两种练气级丹药的炼制要点。
他炼制这几味练气级的丹药，成丹率都能稳定在八成以上，杂质可控、药力均匀，终于按丹峰规矩，在半年前通过了炼丹师认证。
因为成为了炼丹师，楚无忌修为的进境，明显比同样的异灵根弟子都要快上一截，如今刚满十七岁，便已经练气十二层，玄罡练体功也已小成。而同为异灵根的萧安、江不晚都不过才练气十层。
不过炼丹师认证一过，他便被丹峰排入炼丹任务序列，隔三差五就有任务传音符落到他住处，叫他开炉炼丹，用炼丹收益还款。
契约写得明白：收益先还欠款。
丹峰不会因为你学有所成就讲情分，账册上该还的灵石一分也不会少。
账还在，灵石始终宽裕不起来。
练气期丹药的收益薄，扣去按期还款、炼丹灵药、丹炉租借与日常修行所需，手里能攒下的不过是些许灵石；想再往上推衍，筑基丹方、筑基妖核、乃至筑基妖兽血肉，哪一样不是动辄几十上百灵石起步？
宗门规矩，晋级练气级炼丹师后，可以免费从藏经阁领取一份筑基丹方。
他选择的是最基础、炼丹成本最低的筑基丹方鱼龙丹。
此丹不似其他筑基丹药那般需要妖兽妖核或内丹，但是用料所需灵石也不低：需要购买大批筑基大青鱼血肉入药。

哪怕宗门渔场就有饲养的筑基大青鱼，他也买不起青鱼血肉，更别提反复试炼灵丹、推衍丹方火候了。
他没有多余的灵石。
虽然自己知晓原著中诸多机缘，但是没有修为实力支撑，根本无法获取。原著中外海无名岛屿，以后叫碧灵岛的，倒是有个会出极品灵石的灵石矿，但是没有结丹期实力，想都不要想，怕不是半路就被妖兽活活吞吃了。
没办法，楚无忌只能再去找丹峰，凭练气级炼丹师的身份，让丹峰为他再次续上仙道潜力，助他一举迈过筑基炼丹秘术那道门槛。

content_en:
During the review, an idea emerged in Chu Wuji's mind. Alchemy must be quantifiable, engineered, and standardized.
Chu Wuji had already suffered a loss: the so-called "reduce the firepower by three points when you smell a slight bitterness and pungency" sounds like a trick, but when it comes to the fire, it all depends on human heart and feeling.
If you feel "slightly bitter" today, you may feel "scorched" tomorrow; today's "three points" drop is just right, but if the furnace is wetter and the fire spirit sand is more mixed, those "three points" will become a joke. What's more, everyone's senses are sensitive and their spiritual consciousness is different. If the same sentence falls into the hands of different people, the things they refine will naturally vary.
Refining alchemy is very much like ordinary medicine refining and chemical engineering in previous lives: spiritual materials, heat, time, and the state of the furnace are the inputs; the surge of medicinal gas in the furnace, heat transfer and convection, control of spiritual consciousness, and mutual restraint of the medicinal properties are the process; the elixir formation rate, the strength of the medicinal potency, and the amount of impurities are the outputs.
Since the input is operable and the output can be verified and compared, it should not rely entirely on personal experience and feeling. When luck is good, alchemy apprentices can all say that they understand the heat; when luck is bad, no official alchemist can tell where the mistake is.
He knew very well that he was not a genius, nor was he qualified to rely on his personal experience.
People who rely on personal experience and feelings will think that they have mastered the alchemy method after a big success, and they will leave the pot to God when the furnace is useless. What they want is to find a reproducible process window, and push the alchemy skills from relying on feelings little by little to well-documented. Mistakes can be traced, corrections can be tested, and the next furnace can be copied.
So in the third round, he no longer rushed for success, but took apart all the steps and analyzed them.
The medicinal materials are first dried and dehumidified; then ground to control the thickness; and then sieved to make the particle size as consistent as possible.
When taking the medicinal materials, he used his spiritual consciousness to slowly increase the amount from small particles. It would be better to go slower than to allow errors in the amount of medicinal materials to drift randomly. He knew that when refining the low-level spirit gathering powder, it seemed crude, but in fact, he was most afraid that it would be almost the same. If it was just one point off, it would be one batch behind in the end.
Check the alchemy furnace first. After the last alchemy, check whether the furnace is clean, whether the flame formation is stable, and whether the cooling and heating control is smooth. Try to keep the starting point of each alchemy on the same line.
Controlling fire does not rely on experience to guess what "three points" is.
He drew the time scales of the three stages of heating, maintaining and cooling on the jade slips one by one. He determined the heating rate and the temperature stabilization platform. Which stage climbed, which stage stabilized, and which stage switched to cooling. He all followed the nodes he had written down, and the score was accurate every breath.
Then compare these curves with the results of this furnace one by one, and finally summarize the most recommended time-temperature curve.
When the stove lid is opened again, a wave of heat hits your face, but it is not choking.
When the medicinal gas rushed out, it was clear but not turbid. It was neither pungent nor scorching acid. It only touched the tip of the nose lightly, and the magic power was faintly touched.
When the pot comes out of the pot, the fragrance is pure and clean, with a hint of clean coolness; the medicinal powder is as fine as dust and frost, and when it falls into the jade plate, it is loose but not scattered, with no lumps or gray spots.
Chu Wuji stared at the thin layer of medicinal powder for a moment, and his eyes brightened slightly. After the operable input is accurately quantified, and no mistakes are made in the control stage, the output will be predictable and the Qi Gathering Powder of good quality will be released.
Alchemy does not only rely on the alchemist's feeling, but no alchemist has ever been willing to write it down so clearly.
Low-level medicinal powders such as Juqi Powder, which are commonly taken by Qi-refining period disciples, can barely be regarded as Qi-refining-level elixirs. There is no need to condense the powder into a pill, and it can be taken in bulk.
The furnaces are opened every year in the sect, and the refining times are countless. Once the sample size is piled up, it is enough to deduce the optimal ratio and fire range with statistical significance. It's just that this optimal method is ultimately a safe choice for most furnaces. It is still difficult to accurately predict the nuances of a certain furnace, a certain alchemist, a certain alchemy furnace, the humidity of the furnace, or the slightly younger age of the medicinal materials.
As for the high-level elixirs taken by foundation-building and even elixir-forming monks, that is another matter.What a scene.
High-level elixirs often require thousand-year-old elixirs and heavenly materials and earthly treasures. It is rare and expensive, and it is difficult to find a single plant. Even if you want to do a controlled experiment, you cannot afford such consumption. Once there are few samples, the scale of the experiment will be stuck. Many variables can only be deduced and carefully tested. It is difficult to iterate and approach layer by layer like low-level elixirs to obtain the best refining plan.
Therefore, this kind of engineering solution can probably only be used for Qi training, and even some inexpensive foundation-level elixirs. However, even so, the success rate of alchemy that it can increase is not inferior to some foundation-level alchemy secrets.
However, after all, it has only been tested on the Qi-level Qi Gathering Powder so far. To truly call it the foundation-level alchemy secret method, it still has to be successfully applied to the foundation-level elixirs taken by the foundation-building monks. At that time, even if someone deliberately criticizes it, they will be speechless and have no excuse.
It just so happened that Chu Wuji was only at the eighth level of Qi Refining, and there was still some time to polish before building the foundation. After he planned to become a qi-level alchemy master, he would first try out the foundation-building elixir that was the simplest and the cheapest in materials. Based on this, he slowly derived it one by one and applied the engineering plan to the foundation-level elixir, making it a veritable foundation-level elixir secret method.
...
Time flies, four years pass in the blink of an eye.
Perhaps thanks to the spiritual consciousness that was three to four times more powerful than that of monks of the same level brought by time travel, Chu Wuji finally made some progress in alchemy.
With the strength of his spiritual consciousness, he polished the details of fire control, medicine separation, and elixir condensation to a reproducible level, and based on the engineering of Qi Gathering Powder, he successively understood the key points of refining two Qi-level elixirs.
He refined these Qi-level elixirs with a stable elixir yield rate of over 80%, controllable impurities, and even potency. He finally passed the alchemist certification half a year ago according to the rules of the elixir peak.
Because he became an alchemy master, Chu Wuji's progress in cultivation was obviously faster than that of the same disciples of the Foreign Spirit Root. Now that he has just turned seventeen, he has already practiced the twelfth level of Qi, and has also achieved some success in Xuan Gang physical training. Xiao An and Jiang Buwan, who both have supernatural spiritual roots, have only reached the tenth level of Qi training.
However, as soon as he was certified as an alchemist, he was put into the alchemy task sequence by Danfeng. Every now and then, a mission message would fall on his residence, asking him to start an alchemy furnace and use the proceeds from the alchemy to repay the debt.
The contract is clearly written: the proceeds must be paid first.
Danfeng will not show any affection for you because of your academic achievements, and the spiritual stones that should be returned in the account book will not be less.
The accounts are still there, but Lingshi still cannot make money.
The income from elixirs during the Qi training period is small. After deducting regular repayments, alchemy elixirs, leasing alchemy furnaces and daily practice needs, all that can be saved in the hand is a few spirit stones. If you want to go further, foundation-building pills, foundation-building demon cores, and even foundation-building monster flesh and blood, which one does not start with dozens or hundreds of spirit stones?
According to the sect's rules, after being promoted to Qi Lian level alchemist, you can receive a foundation-building elixir recipe from the Sutra Pavilion for free.
He chose the Yulong Pill, the most basic foundation-building pill with the lowest refining cost.
This elixir does not require monster cores or inner elixirs like other foundation-building elixirs, but the spiritual stones required are also high: a large amount of foundation-building herring flesh and blood needs to be purchased for use in the medicine.
Even if there were foundation-building herrings raised in the Zongmen fishery, he couldn't afford herring flesh and blood, let alone repeatedly test the elixir and deduce its recipe.
He has no extra spiritual stones.
Although I am aware of the many opportunities in the original work, I cannot obtain them without the support of my cultivation strength. In the original work, the unnamed island in the outer sea, which will be called Biling Island in the future, does have a spiritual stone mine that can produce the best spiritual stones, but it does not have the strength to form a pill, so don't even think about it, for fear that it will be eaten alive by monsters halfway.
There was no other way, so Chu Wuji could only go to Danfeng again. As a Qi-level alchemist, Danfeng could help him renew his immortal potential and help him cross the threshold of the secret technique of foundation-building alchemy.
